prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished app-icon concept comparison board for the darkly comic sewer-action game DRAIN DAMAGE. Exactly twelve DIFFERENT square icon mockups, arranged 4 columns by 3 rows, evenly spaced on neutral charcoal background. Large crisp numbers 1 through 12 BELOW each square, outside icon artwork, reading left-to-right row-by-row. No other text or labels. Each icon has same rounded-square footprint, strong bold silhouette, rich illustrated game-key-art rendering, subtly weathered metal/porcelain, deep navy/teal backgrounds, copper accents, sludge olive green and punchy red. Professional premium desktop game icon design exploration, readable symbolic compositions, not detailed scenes. Each fills its square with generous edge breathing room. No repeated designs.
1: red rubber plunger wedged in a snarling white porcelain monster jaw with large ceramic teeth; dynamic diagonal, strongest plumbing-combat symbol.
2: Flushfiend, close-up evil toilet monster face: cracked white porcelain, raised toilet lid, glowing red eyes, huge toothy bowl grin.
3: crossed steel pipe wrench and red plunger over an olive sludge splash, exceptionally simple emblem.
4: BJ: battered beige server-rack computer face, green CRT display with two luminous green rectangular eyes and sly simple green mouth, narrow vent strips. Close crop screen dominates, no pipes or toilet parts.
5: rugged plumber work glove clutching a large pipe wrench, sludge dripping from wrench and one small tooth caught in jaw.
6: dark spider face with red eyes, large fangs, white feathery wings framing it, crooked gold halo above; bold dark face white-wing contrast.
7: round iron sewer grate lifted by one claw, two bright red eyes peering from darkness underneath.
8: red plunger pulling an elastic strand of green muck upward, two indignant monster eyes in the muck below; playful grotesque silhouette.
9: one bald sleeping plumber with substantial gray chin beard and separate soul patch, clean upper lip, orange shirt blue bib overalls visible chest-up behind vending-machine glass; small brass dispensing flap beneath, strong simple framing. Only ONE person.
10: oxidized copper pipe elbow, open circular mouth packed with organic monster teeth and dark red interior. Symbolic design only.
11: two heroic plumber faces shoulder-to-shoulder, left Tony dark spiky hair navy work shirt NO overalls; right Sean bald orange shirt blue bib overalls, substantial gray chin beard and separate soul patch, NO mustache or sunglasses; small shared wrench below. Distinct faces, no merged features.
12: cracked white toilet seat ring framing a diagonal bright red plunger, grime and a few green drips, simple bold crest.
No words inside icons, no title typography, no company acronyms, no watermarks. All twelve icons fully visible and independently distinct. Board image landscape high resolution, consistent sizes, accurate numbering. These are selection mockups, not an installed app icon.
notes: Number10 is symbolic icon exploration, not a new canonical monster.
Final standalone icon and platform exports follow selection.
Avoid plot spoilers, obsolete branding and surnames.
